latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of ocd-erp-therapist, a self-directed ERP therapy coaching tool for OCD.

- Guides users through structured ERP sessions with an inhibitory learning approach.
- Includes comprehensive safety screening protocols and crisis resource information.
- Supports automated session reminders, anxiety/willingness check-ins, and progress tracking.
- Offers tools for building fear hierarchies, specialized adaptations, and relapse prevention.
- Emphasizes psychoeducation, ACT willingness, and motivational interviewing principles.
